strongs_1890.strongs_def: a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence
strongs_1890.derivation: or (masculine) מַכֶּה; (plural only) from H5221 (נָכָה); a blow (in 2 Chronicles 2:10, of the flail); by implication,
strongs_1890.kjv_def: beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, [idiom] sore, stripe, stroke, wound(-ed).
